description: This file provides functions to extract and process text content from various file formats such as TXT, PDF, DOCX, and XLSX. It supports comprehensive extraction including handling wide Excel files with chunking and metadata summarization, making it useful for document ingestion and preprocessing in a larger application.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Optional[str]] extract_text_from_bytes(filename: str, content: bytes)
methods.description: Main interface that extracts text content from various supported file types based on filename extension.

methods.name: str _extract_txt(content: bytes)
methods.description: Decodes byte content as UTF-8 ignoring errors.

methods.name: str _extract_pdf(content: bytes)
methods.description: Extracts text from PDF content using pdfminer.six.

methods.name: str _extract_docx(content: bytes)
methods.description: Extracts text from DOCX files using python-docx, including paragraphs and table cells.

methods.name: str _extract_xlsx(content: bytes)
methods.description: Extracts text from XLSX files using openpyxl, returning sheet and cell data.

methods.name: int _estimate_tokens(s: str)
methods.description: Estimates token count for a string, assuming free-text token heuristic (~4 chars per token).

methods.name: str _stringify(cell: Any)
methods.description: Converts various cell values to user-friendly strings.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _compute_column_stats(values: List[Any])
methods.description: Calculates simple descriptive statistics for spreadsheet columns, handling numeric and categorical data.

methods.name: List[str] extract_xlsx_wide_chunks( content: bytes, max_tokens_per_chunk: int = 1200, row_chunk_size: int = 100, base_sample_columns: int = 5, random_sample_columns: int = 3, stats_sample_rows: int = 200, )
methods.description: Produces token-bound, metadata-rich chunks of wide Excel files, including sheet info, sampled data, and statistics, with chunking and trimming to manage size.

methods.name: str summarize_text_preview(text: str, max_chars: int = 500)
methods.description: Generates a compact, single-line preview of extracted text for UI display or confirmation.

methods.name: flush_chunk(rows: List[List[Any]], start_idx: int, end_idx: int)

ctags.name: extract_text_from_bytes
ctags.pattern: /^def extract_text_from_bytes(filename: str, content: bytes) -> Tuple[str, Optional[str]]:$/

ctags.name: extract_xlsx_wide_chunks
ctags.signature: ( content: bytes, max_tokens_per_chunk: int = 1200, row_chunk_size: int = 100, base_sample_columns: int = 5, random_sample_columns: int = 3, stats_sample_rows: int = 200, )

ctags.name: flush_chunk
ctags.pattern: /^        def flush_chunk(rows: List[List[Any]], start_idx: int, end_idx: int):$/
